patterns.desc: identity routing is by app-type, not app-name
driver identity branch -> delivery-company.customers
partner identity collection
customers are central: getCustomerAppName always returns shoofi
the report-path definition of a real order is strictly fulfilled - deliberately stricter than the customer-facing count
there is no single cancelled status - five of them, and summarizeOrderStatuses buckets on this set
the customer-facing order count excludes only never-charged (0) + cancelled, so in-flight orders count - it is looser than COMPLETED_STATUSES on purpose
the admin profile badge count comes from the store-level status join, never from customers.orders[].length - the bounded tail pins the summary to the orders handler

logout sweeps every storeUsers doc sharing the phone - the bounded tail pins the sweep to the logout handler, and it only appears once logout resolves the identity doc by app-type at all (shoofi-server#47)

update-notification-token mirrors the device push token onto every sibling storeUsers doc for the phone (shoofi-server#46) - the mirrored value is what distinguishes this updateMany from the logout sweep (nulls) and the OTP sweep (authCode)
express-jwt v8 writes the verified payload to req.auth - v5's req.user default is gone
the authenticated user is req.auth, never req.user - nothing in the codebase assigns req.user
customers.created is a real BSON Date - a string bound will never match it
orders.created - and the customers.orders[] snapshot of it - is an ISO string with an Israel offset, the opposite type from customers.created on the same document
unblocking $sets the flag to false and never $unsets it - so isBlocked is three-state (true / false / absent) and only === true means blocked
the codebase-wide 'not blocked' test is $ne true, not $exists or false - because of the three states above
the reason/who/when for a block lives in a customers.notes[] entry under category 'restriction' - there is no blockReason or blockedAt field
restriction notes are system notes, and the note edit/delete handlers 403 those - the reason is an immutable audit record, surface it read-only
the flag and its reason are written in ONE updateOne, so they can never diverge - do not split them into two writes
block and cash are two independent actions, so a customer restricted both ways has TWO restriction notes - reading notes[] with $slice 1 silently drops one of the two reasons

notes are pushed at position 0, which is what makes $slice 1 look safe - rank the per-source pair by createdAt instead, and treat a newest 'unblock' as no current reason rather than reusing the lifted block's reason
per-store token re-mint mechanism
admin uses Bearer (RN apps use 'Token')
